cross_references.popular_name: Tom Bane Civil Rights Act (Bane Act)
cross_references.relationship: IMPORTANT: The Bane Act has its OWN remedies provision built into Section 52.1 itself. Bane Act claims are NOT remedied through Section 52. Section 52.1 provides treble damages, attorney's fees, and a civil penalty independently. Do not confuse them.
Section 52(f) provides that aggrieved persons may file administrative complaints with the Civil Rights Department under this section as an alternative to court action.

Federal counterpart — Section 1988 provides attorney's fees for federal civil rights claims the same way Section 52 provides them for state civil rights claims. Both serve the same function: making civil rights cases economically viable for attorneys to take.
